headline: About Me
paragraphs: I specialize in developing websites, products, and tools for digital marketing.

My typical work day includes building conversion-centric marketing websites, setting up tracking and analytics services, researching and building AI apps, advising on marketing campaigns, and publishing my own open-source tools.
My past clients have ranged from small startups, household brands, Fortune 500s, pharma, state and local government, and international holding companies.
